response.text: I'll start with set-based checks: journal balance, closed-period postings, AP-to-GL tie-out, duplicate invoices, and invalid accounts.

arguments.sql: SELECT h.JRNL_NO, SUM(l.DR_AMT) AS dr, SUM(l.CR_AMT) AS cr FROM GLJRNH h JOIN GLJRNL l ON l.JRNL_NO = h.JRNL_NO GROUP BY h.JRNL_NO HAVING SUM(l.DR_AMT) <> SUM(l.CR_AMT)
SELECT h.JRNL_NO, h.PRD_ID, h.POST_DT, p.STRT_DT, p.END_DT, p.CLOSE_DT FROM GLJRNH h JOIN GLPERD p ON p.PRD_ID = h.PRD_ID WHERE p.STAT_CD = 'C' AND h.POST_DT > COALESCE(p.CLOSE_DT, p.END_DT)

SELECT i.INV_ID, i.VEND_CD, i.INV_NO, i.INV_AMT, i.STAT_CD, i.JRNL_NO, (SELECT SUM(p.PAY_AMT) FROM APPAYM p WHERE p.INV_ID = i.INV_ID) AS paid FROM APINVH i WHERE i.STAT_CD = 'P' AND COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.PAY_AMT) FROM APPAYM p WHERE p.INV_ID = i.INV_ID),0) <> i.INV_AMT

SELECT a.INV_ID, b.INV_ID AS dup_id, a.VEND_CD, a.INV_NO, a.INV_AMT, a.INV_DT FROM APINVH a JOIN APINVH b ON b.INV_ID > a.INV_ID AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(a.VEND_CD,'[^A-Za-z0-9]','','g')),'0')) = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(b.VEND_CD,'[^A-Za-z0-9]','','g')),'0')) AND LTRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(a.INV_NO),'[^A-Z0-9]','','g'),'0') = LTRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(b.INV_NO),'[^A-Z0-9]','','g'),'0')
SELECT l.JRNL_NO, l.LN_SEQ, l.ACCT_CD FROM GLJRNL l LEFT JOIN GLCOA c ON TRIM(c.ACCT_CD) = TRIM(l.ACCT_CD) WHERE c.ACCT_CD IS NULL
